You arrive in a kitchen. An usual kind of place. You decide to start listing off everything you see in the room, as if you were in a text adventure.

You see a fridge. There's something strange about this being here, but you can't put your finger on it. You see an oven. You check the price tag on the oven. Two hundred big ones?! That's ridiculous! You know my buddy, they work for the post office? I'm sure my friend could get you one of those for 40 bucks! You can make out a table. But the thing hasn't got anything on it.
